widgetTool.name: mortgage_kyc
widgetTool.description: Emit a KYC document upload prompt for mortgage application. Follow with mobile_handoff if on mobile. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'I will need you to upload a document.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False.

fields.description: Required. Ordered list of KYC fields to collect. Prefill values may be passed from session state when known.

field_id.description: One of: gross_annual_income_cad | employment_status | employer_name | years_employed | monthly_debt_obligations_cad | property_type | property_city | province.

help_text.description: Optional one-line clarifier under the input.

options.description: For input_kind=select. Each item is a plain string.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'mortgage_kyc'

submit_cta_label.description: Primary button label, e.g. 'See my pre-approval'.

submit_cta_value.description: Sent to the agent on submit. The widget appends the collected values as a JSON object.

subtitle.description: One calm sentence explaining why we need this to give a pre-approval estimate.

title.description: Form header, e.g. 'A few last details'.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
